title: JustCoffee
titleCn: Just Coffee咖啡公司论文辅导

paragraphs.text: To a student called
Lina.
Lina has written an essay about a company called Just Coffee, which works with coffee producers all over the world.
First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-six on page six.
Now listen carefully and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-six.

Right, Lina. On the whole, your essay on Just Coffee was well-researched and made a much better impression on me than your last assignment. Several of you chose to write about Just Coffee, in fact, so I feel I've learnt a lot about the company too.
Good. But I was a bit disappointed with the grade I was given. Where did I go wrong?
Well, it was an interesting choice of company, and it gave you a lot to say, but you could have expressed it better in places. It sounded a bit informal at times.
Oh, dear.
But I have to say, you obviously put more time into the planning stage this time.
Yes, I did. In my last essay, I didn't really think about how the essay should develop, which meant I ended up repeating a lot of details.

Well, you can see how helpful planning is now. However, a couple of other points also let you down. Although your profile covered the five main areas we asked you to research: operation, products, shareholders, objectives, and mission statement, you should have spent more time on layout, just making sure that it looks professional.
Sorry about that. I'm still not a hundred percent confident with the graphic software.

Okay. It was also handed in after the deadline. That automatically means you're penalized. However, it was very satisfactory on the whole. Read my notes at the end, but I'd like to run through a few minor points with you, too.
Fine.

So Just Coffee. Y- you covered the company's operation well, but I think you could have added more about how the company supports the communities where the coffee is produced. They focus on this a lot in their advertising.
You mean in practical terms?
Yes. I was thinking specifically of the fact that it offers producers up to sixty percent of the value of the coffee in advance of delivery.
Which makes it possible for them to cover startup equipment and employment costs in the field.
Precisely. And you mentioned that Just Coffee pays its growers more than the standard global rate, but you didn't quote any precise figures.
It's double, isn't it? I know it's very generous.
Triple, in fact. And apparently, it pays a premium to growers who produce organic crops, too.
I didn't know that.
Well, it's too late to include that now, but you really ought to have done a bit more research on the impact of the company on its local growers.
I did mention how some coffee producers in Haiti are producing enough coffee to sell to other markets, too.

Yes, I remember that. But in Peru, the company suggested that farmers experiment with different kinds of coffee at different altitudes. That's an interesting development, and it would have been good to mention it.
I didn't know about that. Can you give me some information about it?
Yes. We've got a collection of articles on Just Coffee in a folder here, which I'll give you in a minute.
Before you hear the rest of the discussion, you have some time to look at questions twenty-seven to thirty on page seven.
Now listen and answer questions twenty-seven to thirty.
Now, talking of reference materials.
Yes?
I think Just Coffee is a very interesting company, so I'd like you to compile a reference document to add to the department's library file.
Oh, okay. What should it include?
Well, it would be useful to say something about their range of products. How many are there on the market at the moment?
Eight in total.
Okay. A quick description of each one.
And what about a section on the local profit and how it's used to help the local community? I thought that was interesting.
It's a bit of a diversion, but why not? If I remember correctly, it's used to purchase computers, among other things.
Yes, that's right. It's great that the profit is plowed back like that. Lots of customers buy their products for that reason alone.
You're right. Okay, and say something about the most important advantage for producers who work with Just Coffee. Would you say that it's the trading partnership?

In all the literature, the term they use is knowledge sharing, so perhaps I should quote that. It's called that because the company doesn't only buy the coffee from the suppliers, it also gives them advice on market conditions and export strategies.
Good.
I'll give this some more thought and drop a brief for you to work with. There's no rush for this, so don't worry.
Okay, thanks.
That is the end of section three.
